desc: Derive the feasibility condition: \(R\) must be even, and if \(R=0\), \(B\) must be even.
Develop constructions for red-only, blue-only, and even-\(B\) mixed cases.
Handle the \(R=2,B=0\) and \(R=0,B=2\) cases with adjacent squares.
Fix the syntax error in the blue-only construction.
Correct the positive-\(R\), odd-\(B\) construction and verify cyclic closure.
Validate all constructions with a semantic constructive checker.
Confirm output formatting and provide the final corrected \(O(R+B)\) implementation.
